u0: Initial or uncounted state: no non-exit step with holding_box has been credited, and the agent is not currently carrying the box. The box may be loose on the floor. Next objective: pick up the box and keep holding it through a non-exit move to enter u1 and earn the first carrying bonus; going straight to the exit now is only a partial-reward fallback.
u1: One carrying credit: the agent has held the box on one non-exit step and earned the first small bonus, but has not yet held it on a second such step. It may still be holding the box or may have dropped or lost it. Next objective: keep or reacquire the box and carry it through another non-exit step to advance to u2; exiting while holding the box is also a full-reward finish, while exiting empty-handed gives only partial reward.
u2: Two carrying credits: the agent has held the box on at least two non-exit steps, earning both small bonuses. Further holding is not required by the reward machine. Whether the box is still in hand or has been dropped or lost, the next objective is to reach the exit; from this state any exit gives the full terminal reward.
u3: Terminal state: the exit has been reached and the episode is over. There is no next objective; the final reward is already fixed, with full reward from u2 or from u1 while holding the box at the exit, and partial reward for other exit paths such as u0 or u1 without the box.
